label: PrivOS unified
_note: Single MCP tool catalog for the PrivOS unified stack. Chat rooms, tasks and CRM records share one data model over hub /api/v1 REST, so one server with a small tool set covers all three domains. See docs/references.md.

get_messages.name: privos_get_messages
get_messages.description: Fetch recent messages from a room (channel, discussion, or DM).

list_items.name: privos_list_items
list_items.description: Read or query items in a list. Lists back both tasks and CRM records; fields are the list's columns.

upsert_item.name: privos_upsert_item
upsert_item.description: Create or update a list item (task or CRM record). Omit itemId to create; supply itemId to update. Fields are keyed by the list's column names.

itemId.description: The item id; omit to create a new item

fields.description: Field values keyed by field name
